meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative data. This demonstration is not connected to Karnataka Government systems. Personal names in the registers are masked.
meta.boundaryNote: District boundaries follow the Census 2011 outline. Vijayanagara is not drawn separately on this illustrative map.
meta.separationNote: Registered workers, active members, dependents and beneficiaries are separate counts. A person is counted once in the unique beneficiary total.
meta.stageNote: Approved assistance and disbursed assistance are separate. Remaining balance is available funds minus successful disbursement. Failed and returned payments are not treated as disbursed.
meta.schemeNote: Scheme categories come from this illustrative scheme master. They are not a verified list of officially active schemes.
meta.fundNote: Available funds ₹1,860 Cr. Allocated funds ₹1,560 Cr. Approved assistance ₹1,420 Cr. Disbursed assistance ₹1,250 Cr. Remaining balance is available funds minus disbursed assistance.
